_doc: Backtest windows (briefs/ready-skeptic.md §3). 'lander' is written as .cinq/config.json in the prep commit, the lander's own override hook (app/worker/src/lander/server.cjs repoConfig). 'local' is how oracle.mjs runs the same suite on this machine. Window dates are UTC, inclusive.

hono.why: 6 PRs on src/client/client.ts by 4 authors in 5 days; 4 merged within 26 minutes on Aug 22
notes: Upstream ships bun.lock, which the lander does not read, so it falls back to npm install without a lockfile. Dependency versions can drift from upstream's (UNVERIFIED effect).
Measured on Windows/Node 22.23.3: --project main, 3,956 tests, 66 s; 1 compress streaming test timed out under load (the lander's one-re-run flake rule covers it).

es-toolkit.why: words.ts touched by 3 PRs (2 authors) and dedent.ts by 2 PRs within days
notes: tests/check-dist.spec.ts builds and packs the tarball (197 s, failed on Windows paths), so it is excluded from gating and from O3, and listed as excluded in the report.

Yarn 4 defaults to PnP, and the lander calls `npx --no-install vitest`, which needs node_modules. Hence YARN_NODE_LINKER=node-modules (UNVERIFIED: --immutable is not used in case the linker switch touches the install state).
The yarn release path is pinned to the version at the window base (yarn-4.12.0.cjs); select.mjs records it.

fastify.why: a chain of breaking deprecation removals touching fastify.js, lib/warnings.js and the generated lib/config-validator.js; terse PR descriptions
notes: BLOCKED for the product run: the lander's node --test path cannot exclude test/build/** (a build test that hit its 30 s timeout under load), and fastify's suite runs through borp, not plain node --test discovery. Run hono and es-toolkit first.
